summary_en: Japan Post Bank will acquire up to 15 million ordinary shares (0.4% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 30 billion yen through ToSTNeT-3 and market purchases from November 17, 2026 to January 29, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
Japan Post Bank announced on November 13, 2026 that its board of directors approved the acquisition of treasury stock to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns, consistent with the bank's medium-term management plan (fiscal 2026-2028) that balances shareholder distribution, financial soundness, and growth investment.

The buyback framework authorizes acquisition of up to 15 million ordinary shares at a maximum total cost of 30 billion yen (equivalent to 0.4% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) during the period from November 17, 2026 through January 29, 2027. The bank will use two methods: ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange matching trades) at the previous day's closing price and market purchases under a discretionary investment agreement. Notably, the parent company Japan Post Co., Ltd. (which holds approximately 49.9% of voting rights) has agreed to participate in the ToSTNeT-3 tranches by offering shares, provided the bank maintains its voting stake above one-third as required under the Postal Service Privatization Law as amended in June 2026. The bank noted that the actual execution may fall substantially short of the authorized maximum if market conditions deteriorate or if the parent company's participation changes the overall capital structure. As of the announcement, the bank confirmed possessing sufficient distributable profits to execute the buyback under current conditions, though this assertion is contingent on financial market stability.
